manual.description: Verify that each production, production-config, and release Environment is restricted to branch main; GitHub's branch-policy API may omit whether a matching name targets a branch or tag.
Verify that main has no bypass actor and release-tag rulesets allow only repository administrators; GitHub may omit bypass_actors from responses available to a read-only API caller.

Before making a derived repository public, confirm both settings in Settings > Code security and analysis; the authenticated, read-only API caller used by security:doctor cannot inspect these repository administration settings.

Before making a derived repository public, confirm private vulnerability reporting is enabled in the Security tab; the authenticated, read-only API caller used by security:doctor cannot inspect this setting.
